verdict.rationale: A spreadsheet add-in is a fair question for an FP&A planning platform like Pigment, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an Excel or Google Sheets add-in, either for pulling live data into spreadsheets or for writing edits back. The generic "native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports" claim is an adjacent integration capability, not a bi-directional spreadsheet add-in, so it earns no credit here.
